heroHeadline: ARTEMIS II SPLASHDOWN FOOTAGE RELEASED — INSIDE VIEW OF ORION CAPSULE RE-ENTRY
heroSubtitle: Oct 8: Footage released from inside the Orion capsule captures Artemis II re-entry, parachute deployment, and splashdown. Oct 7: NASA is advancing plans to build a nuclear fission reactor on the lunar surface. Oct 3: GAO found NASA has no single authoritative cost estimate for its Moon-to-Mars program.
